pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū vikāle gāmaṃ pavisitvā sabhāyaṃ nisīditvā anekavihitaṃ tiracchānakathaṃ kathenti seyyath' īdaṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:1.3: rājakathaṃ corakathaṃ mahāmattakathaṃ senākathaṃ bhayakathaṃ yuddhakathaṃ annakathaṃ pānakathaṃ vatthakathaṃ sayanakathaṃ mālākathaṃ gandhakathaṃ ñātikathaṃ yānakathaṃ gāmakathaṃ nigamakathaṃ nagarakathaṃ janapadakathaṃ itthikathaṃ surākathaṃ visikhākathaṃ kumbhaṭṭhānakathaṃ pubbapetakathaṃ nānatthakathaṃ lokakkhāyikaṃ samuddakkhāyikaṃ itibhavābhavakathaṃ iti vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:1.5: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā vikāle gāmaṃ pavisitvā sabhāyaṃ nisīditvā anekavihitaṃ tiracchānakathaṃ kathessanti seyyath' īdaṃ . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:1.8: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:1.10: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū vikāle gāmaṃ . . . kathessanti . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:1.13: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave vikāle gāmaṃ . . . kathetha . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:1.18: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā vikāle gāmaṃ . . . kathessatha . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:1.21: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:1.22: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:1.23.1: yo pana bhikkhu vikāle gāmaṃ paviseyya, pācittiyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:1.24: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:2.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū Kosalesu janapadesu Sāvatthiṃ gacchantā sāyaṃ aññataraṃ gāmaṃ upagacchiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:2.2: manussā te bhikkhū passitvā etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:2.5: bhagavatā paṭikkhittaṃ vikāle gāmaṃ pavisitun ti kukkuccāyantā na pāvisiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:2.7: atha kho te bhikkhū Sāvatthiṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:2.9: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:2.10: anujānāmi bhikkhave āpucchā vikāle gāmaṃ pavisituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:2.11: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:2.12.1: yo pana bhikkhu anāpucchā vikāle gāmaṃ paviseyya, pācittiyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:2.13: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||2||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:3.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu Kosalesu janapadesu Sāvatthiṃ gacchanto sāyaṃ aññataraṃ gāmaṃ upagacchi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:3.2: manussā taṃ bhikkhuṃ passitvā etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:3.5: bhagavatā paṭikkhittaṃ anāpucchā vikāle gāmaṃ pavisitun ti kukkuccāyanto na pāvisi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:3.7: atha kho so bhikkhu Sāvatthiṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:3.9: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:3.10: anujānāmi bhikkhave santaṃ bhikkhuṃ āpucchā vikāle gāmaṃ pavisituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:3.11: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:3.12.1: yo pana bhikkhu santaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpucchā vikāle gāmaṃ paviseyya, pācittiyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:3.13: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||3||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:4.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu ahinā daṭṭho hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:4.2: aññataro bhikkhu aggiṃ āharissāmīti gāmaṃ gacchati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:4.4: bhagavatā paṭikkhittaṃ santaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpucchā vikāle gāmaṃ pavisitun ti kukkuccāyanto na pāvisi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:4.6: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:4.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave tathārūpe accāyike karaṇīye santaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpucchā vikāle gāmaṃ pavisituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:4.8: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:4.9.1: yo pana bhikkhu santaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpucchā vikāle gāmaṃ paviseyya aññatra tathārūpā accāyikā karaṇīyā, pācittiyan ti. ||4||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:5.1.12: parikkhittassa gāmassa parikkhepaṃ atikkamantassa āpatti pācittiyassa,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:5.1.13: aparikkhittassa gāmassa upacāraṃ okkamantassa āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc85:5.2.1: vikāle vikālasaññī santaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpucchā gāmaṃ pavisati aññatra tathārūpā accāyikā karaṇīyā, āpatti pācittiyassa.
